CustomField.description: Packaged baseline instructions. This is NOT the live prompt once the agent has Agent_Prompt_Version__c records — AgentEngine resolves the active version and only falls back to this field when no version exists. Edit the prompt from the Agent Builder, which creates a new version.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Packaged baseline only. The live prompt is the agent's active Prompt Version — edit it in the Agent Builder, not here.
